simple.meaning: עֵזֶר (ʻêzer) is a Hebrew object word meaning “aid.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 2:18. The surrounding context includes family, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֵזֶר (H5828) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: עֵזֶר (ʻêzer) / H5828 is traced through Genesis 2:18, Genesis 2:20, Exodus 18:4, Deuteronomy 33:7 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to‡ or, suitable for, or appropriate for. him.”

timeline.evidenceText: Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to‡ or, suitable for, or appropriate for. him.”
The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.
The name of the other was Eliezer,† Eliezer means “God is my helper”. for he said, “My father’s God was my help and delivered me from Pharaoh’s sword.”
This is for Judah. He said,
“There is no one like God, Jeshurun,
Our soul has waited for Yahweh.
I have found David, my servant.
House of Aaron, trust in Yahweh!
You who fear Yahweh, trust in Yahweh!
I will lift up my eyes to the hills.
Our help is in Yahweh’s name,
Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help,
They shall all be ashamed because of a people that can’t profit them, that are not a help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.”
I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands. I will draw out the sword after them.
